name: Kind Mule 56
author: ForzDz
description: Amber toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #ccc to #ffc300, transform becomes scale(1.2), starts the bounce animation (pulsing). Clicking it toggles it: text color changes from #ccc to #ffc300, transform becomes scale(1.2), starts the bounce animation (pulsing).
